correctness.rationale: Reconstructed regenerative first and second moments for V→(V or empty) excursions. Exact identity 1−CV²=2E(LI)/μ−p E L²/μ²; positive cuts give p=R_G/(nλ^{n−1})+O(λ^{-n}) and E(LI)=C_G/(2nλ^n)+O(λ^{-n−1}). Uniform O(λ^{-1}) excursion moments remove the remaining term at order λ^{-n−1}; n≥2 fixed and all infection/recovery assumptions explicit. Independently computed K2 exact mean (λ+3)/2 and CV²=(λ+1)(λ+5)/(λ+3)² (limit deficit 4), and P4/star exact R=8,C=38 versus 112/3, matching the theorem. Inspected check.py actual generator and rational elimination, not relying on terminal PASS alone.
residual_risks: The proof is high-transmission at fixed graph only, not uniform over n; infection-containing rare excursions are controlled by tail bounds, not enumerated exhaustively.
